title: [PM seat] domain:skills @ objectui — ⏳ vacant
body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills seat on objectui (`domain:skills @ objectui`, seat 1).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at objectstack `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. The lane's objectstack post is objectstack-ai/objectstack#7623; the two posts are one seat on two boards. Body **r10**, written 2026-10-02T21:05Z at 收班 on the maintainer's word 「当前任务处理完就下班」 by `session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ` (os-elon-musk): the seat is vacant, two Tier H PRs of this board are left on watch. r9 (standby after wave 7) and earlier revisions are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** · former: `session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ` (os-elon-musk), seated 2026-10-01T23:35Z, stood down 2026-10-02T21:05Z; its patrol Routine is deleted. 留守 (named items only): PR #11480 and PR #11507 stay subscribed by that session, which lands and closes them out on approval; no queue read, no dispatch. Reads of this board go through REST with the session token; writes through objectstack's `scripts/pm/` tools with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` (route `dispatch`). Hand-over: `/pm-dispatch skills` + read objectstack-ai/objectstack#7623, then this post; the release marker is the 收班简报 comment below.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **In the landing window (ACCEPTed, Tier H, awaiting an APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`; both green, mergeable, `needs-user-decision` + review requests on):** PR #11480 (#11471, `rules/protocol.md`: the `BreakpointColumnMap` parenthetical names the `ResponsiveGrid` `columns` prop's type instead of the retired `responsive-grid` key; head `1078b79c`; contract review 5956142074, ACCEPT 5956151422, 速读 5956170998) · PR #11507 (#11503, `guides/project-setup.md` CLI table: `objectui add` row deleted, `analyze` row = the bundle-size report over `dist/`; head `6604f48f`; contract review 5961287397, ACCEPT 5961296120, 速读 5961307035). Closeout after MERGED: strip `pm:dispatched` + assignee from #11471 / #11503, drop the PR's stale `needs-user-decision`, landing note (staged action files are in the departing session only; the ops are three per card).
- **Landed on this board this shift: 4, every card closed out** — PR #11410 (#11009), #11418 (#11414), #11419 (#11256), #11427 (#11198); heads and notes in r9.
- **Queue** (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`, read 2026-10-02T21:05Z): **0.** **Decision box (this lane, this board): 0.** No bare `finding` on this board (#11321 closed by its lane).
- **Cross-lane memo:** #11500 (`domain:ui`, dispatched by that seat) retires `create plugin` / `lint` / `test` / `studio`; when it lands, `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`'s CLI table owes the same pass as #11503 — on a card (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21467 records why not a bare grep). Triage's proposal to fold #11503 into PR #11480 was declined on the claim (5960912895).

## Hot-file serial queue

- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → PR #11480; `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` → PR #11507 (both this seat's, in the landing window; different files, no ordering between them). Every other file of the lane on this board: FREE.

## Notes

- **Landing on this board.** `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**` are objectui's governed surfaces: a PR touching any stays draft until an APPROVED review by `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`); then the seat lands it (ready + auto-merge → the merge queue; a direct merge is refused 405). The dev-side governed pre-check is `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test PATHS` in this repo.
- **Changesets.** A docs-only PR carries an EMPTY-frontmatter changeset; the `skip-changeset` label object exists on this board but is a phantom wired to nothing — ⛔ never apply it.
- **Comments.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` bans model identifiers in comments; the claim recogniser accepts the model-free ceiling spelling `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with `MANDATORY` cited on the same line; every claim on this board uses it.
- **Gates for `skills/**` edits**: `check:skills-paths`, `check:skill-examples` (needs a `--build-filter` scoped build under objectstack's `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, ~3–4 min), `check:skill-eval-tokens` (an eval-token oracle, not a size meter — objectui has no skills line/token ratchet; the seat budgets LINES per card), `check:new-line-citations` (differential; cite by content, never a path with a line number), `lint.yml`'s roster (its decide step excludes `**/*.md` and `.changeset/**`, so a docs-only PR reports with steps skipped); `doc-version-claims.test.ts` is the one test that reads `guides/project-setup.md`.
- **Platform readings this shift:** container Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom@30's `^22.22.2` floor under this repo's `engine-strict` — every dev installed with `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` (recorded as a deviation each time); the write budget (40 / trailing hour) is shared with objectstack's seat and devs — see objectstack-ai/objectstack#7623 Notes ①; `fleet-write` validate refuses an actions file packed as an object (wave 9's dev repacked as an array, zero writes lost).
- **Deploy registration.** A merge to `main` publishes nothing by itself (publishing runs only through `changeset-release.yml`'s explicit publish lane); the published skills catalog ships by `npx skills add`, so a wrong `skills/**` line is installed elsewhere before anyone here reads it.
- **Checkout**: `/home/user/objectui` fast-forwarded to `origin/main` on every patrol; the mirror branch carries no seat content.
